svg.aria-label: devops: Infra changes, in a fixed order. Three sub-skills: change, release-scope, network-diagram. Steps: Triage, what broke, and its SEV level; Investigate, read-only first; Plan, steps and rollback, approved; Change, one step at a time; Verify, the same command as before; Report, before, steps, after, rollback. Output: a change record with its SEV level and timeline.
